meta.name: review
meta.description: Review a branch or PR for merge readiness and produce a QA report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查分支或PR的合并就绪状态并生成QA报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在合并代码前确保质量和完整性
copy.tagline_en: Review a branch or PR for merge readiness and produce a QA report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure code quality and completeness before merging

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会作为 QA 人员，审查分支或 PR 的合并准备情况，检查正确性、回归、安全风险等，并生成一份 QA 报告，保存到 docs/qa/reports/ 目录。
howto.when: 当你提供 PR 链接、分支名或描述一组变更，并要求进行合并审查时触发。默认在 QA 角色下运行。

say.text: 检查我的 feature-x 分支是否可合并。
say.note: Claude 会将 feature-x 与基础分支对比。

say.text: 帮我审查最近的三次提交。
say.note: 指定变更范围，Claude 按流程检查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a QA reviewer: it examines a branch or PR for merge readiness (correctness, regressions, security risks, etc.) and saves a QA report to docs/qa/reports/.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a PR URL, branch name, or describe changes and ask for a merge review. Runs under the QA persona by default.

say_en.note: Claude fetches the PR and runs the review.

say_en.text: Check if my feature-x branch is ready to merge.
say_en.note: Compares feature-x to its base branch.
Specifies change scope for the review.
